title: b7z9.25.b: wire hold-off expiry to desync+rejoin (R-02a-043)
description: Child of b7z9.25 (spec 02a 2a.5.3/2a.6, R-02a-043): after 3-superframe hold-off the node MUST initiate desync+rejoin, but advance_holdoff()==True is only a signal wired to nothing. Python: python/src/lichen/link/slot_coordination.py:48,359-376; Rust: rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs:840,1108-1122. Deliverable: the production FSM/timer owner consumes the hold-off expiry and performs desync + rejoin initiation, with tests asserting the rejoin fires at the hold-off boundary in both languages.
